data.description: 【希耶尔 · 圣堂教坛前法衣半褪的自抚】幽暗清冷的圣堂大厅内，高耸彩窗透下银蓝月光。希耶尔深蓝修女法衣被解开带子半褪至腰际，露出圆润白皙的雪乳与饱满紧致的腰臀。她双手撑在沉重的橡木教坛长桌边缘俯身弓腰，单手探入裙底拉开内裤边缘自抚湿润的花瓣，推了推微斜的眼镜。耳根红透，回头回眸时眼眸水雾迷离——「就算身为代行者……面对你的时候……身体也会彻底诚实呢……」

data.promptProse: Bent forward over the polished oak altar table inside the darkened church under cool blue moonbeams, Ciel arches her supple back in solitary, breathless surrender. Her navy-blue clergy habit is loosened and drawn high around her waist, hands gripping the smooth wood while her fingers reach down to draw her panties aside and caress her dripping, sensitive entrance. Looking back over her bare shoulder with tear-filled sapphire eyes and flushed red ears behind tilted glasses, she gasps softly in the sacred silence. Dynamic horizontal anime visual novel composition, solo 1girl, no text.
